thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging grace (oncall) — high-severity alert from AcmeCorp (dedicated pool: acme-pool-42). Model-quality regression detected after recent quantization profile rollout. Error rate / low-confidence up 28% for chat-response scoring. Tenant impact: degraded responses. Please ack and triage.

grace (oncall): ACK. Jumping in. @samir (ml-engineer) can you confirm what changed?

samir (ml-engineer): looking. We deployed a new quantization profile (q8_fast_v2) to reduce p99 inference cost for many tenants. It rolled to acme-pool-42 at 03:12 UTC yesterday during the rolling rollout. I'm seeing QA evals show a BLEU-style metric drop and human feedback flags for hallucination-like outputs specifically on their finetuned assistant.

tia (sre): can you attach the diffs / config? any crash/oom logs?

samir (ml-engineer): attaching quick snippet of the diffs and recent model metadata: ```diff
- quant_profile: q8_default
+ quant_profile: q8_fast_v2
```
Sample inference anomaly: ```
request_id: req-0x9ff
model: acme-assistant-v3
input: "Summarize earnings call"
response: "Company made $0 revenue" <-- incorrect, confidence low
```
No OOMs, just quality regressions. CPU/GPU metrics normal.

karen (customer-success): Acme support ticket just escalated — they reported multiple inaccurate summaries to their compliance team. They're asking for ETA and rollback. I'm on a call; please prioritize.

grace (oncall): ok containment plan: 1) isolate acme-pool-42 to stop further rollout surface area 2) revert quant profile for acme-pool-42 to q8_default 3) run fast quality smoke tests against customer prompt set 4) communicate to Acme with interim mitigations. Assigning tasks: @marta to isolate/reroute, @samir to prepare revert artifact, @tia to run smoke tests and monitor.

marta (platform): on it. I can pin routing for acme-pool-42 to the previous variant and disable automated rollouts. Command I'll run (dry-run first): ```bash
# pin the pool to previous quant profile
redwoodctl pools update acme-pool-42 --set quant_profile=q8_default --no-apply-rollout
# ensure no auto promotions
redwoodctl rollouts suspend --pool acme-pool-42
```
I will run as dry-run and report back.

samir (ml-engineer): prepping the revert bundle now. It's essentially the prior quantized artifact we keep in S3: `s3://redwood-models/acme-assistant-v3/q8_default/2025-08-01.tar.gz`. Re-deploy steps: unpin & replace with that artifact, restart pool workers gracefully with rolling-restart to avoid inflight dropped requests.

tia (sre): started smoke tests against Acme prompt set (subset of 120 prompts) in a staging replica of acme-pool-42. Early results: current (q8_fast_v2) precision: 0.61, recall-like score: 0.59. Baseline (q8_default) expected precision ~0.78. I'll run full set and post numbers.

marta (platform): dry-run successful — RBAC and apply hooks okay. Scheduling actual change in 5m. Will throttle to 10% of nodes first (canary).

acme-support-bot: Notification to AcmeCorp: "We are investigating reported quality issues with your dedicated inference pool. Our team is prioritizing a rollback. We will update within 30 minutes."

grace (oncall): executing canary revert now. @samir coordinate on the canary and watch metrics: quality score, latency, token cost. Keep canary for 10 minutes then decision to ramp.

samir (ml-engineer): canary revert applied to 2/20 nodes in acme-pool-42. Running evaluation harness: ```bash
python -m evaluations.run --pool acme-pool-42 --profile q8_default --promptset acme/priority_smoke
```
Initial canary results (after 4 minutes): quality -> 0.79 (up from 0.61), latency +3% p95 (acceptable). No regression in throughput.

tia (sre): production monitors show the canary nodes receiving routed traffic and success ratio for those nodes at 99.6%. Overall pool success ratio improving slightly. No errors.

karen (customer-success): On the call with Acme now — they asked for timeframe. I told them we started a rollback canary and seeing positive signals. They want full revert ASAP and a short postmortem. They also asked for a rollback-only IP to prevent future auto-rollouts to their pool.

grace (oncall): agreed action items: 1) full revert to q8_default for acme-pool-42 (marta) 2) pin customer pool and disable automated rollout for that tenant (marta) 3) run full smoke tests and baseline metrics (tia & samir) 4) customer communication + PSR (karen) 5) create incident follow-up & postmortem (grace). ETA for full revert: target +22 minutes from now.

marta (platform): rolling revert started. Steps: ```bash
# 1) apply artifact
redwoodctl pools update acme-pool-42 --artifact s3://redwood-models/acme-assistant-v3/q8_default/2025-08-01.tar.gz
# 2) restart workers gracefully
redwoodctl pools restart acme-pool-42 --strategy rolling --max-unavailable 1
# 3) set tenant pin
redwoodctl pools annotate acme-pool-42 --annotation rollout.disabled=true
```
Progress: reverting nodes 1-6/20.

samir (ml-engineer): watching model outputs. Spot-checks look good. Will kick off the full 120-prompt run now.

tia (sre): full smoke run progress: 40/120 done, current aggregate quality 0.80. No new anomalies.

marta (platform): revert complete on 20/20 nodes. Pool now pinned. Verified config: `rollout.disabled=true`.

grace (oncall): excellent. Running final validation for 15m to confirm stability, then we'll send update to Acme. Also flagging for postmortem to capture why q8_fast_v2 passed our pre-rollout checks but still failed on this tenant's finetuned assistant.

acme-support-bot: Update to AcmeCorp: "Rollback complete. We reverted your pool to the previous quantization profile. We're validating quality and will follow up with a postmortem. If you see any remaining bad outputs please file a ticket and we'll prioritize. — Redwood Support"

karen (customer-success): Acme accepted the rollback, they reported immediate improvements on a few samples. Asked for a timeline for root-cause and preventive controls (can’t accept surprise rollouts).

samir (ml-engineer): initial hypothesis: q8_fast_v2 introduced a subtle edge-case in quantization of attention projection that interacts with the assistant's sparse fine-tuning distribution. It didn't trigger generic evals because it's specific to their prompt distribution and finetune. Need a targeted regression harness per-tenant for sensitive enterprise models.

grace (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 20 minutes. @marta you'll be T0 for follow-ups, @samir owner for ML root-cause and remediation, @tia for SRE validation for 24h, @karen to coordinate customer comms and postmortem. I'll create the incident ticket and assign owners.

marta (platform): acknowledged. I'll watch the pool and ensure no accidental rollouts. I'll also add a guard to prevent auto-promote to any pool annotated `rollout.disabled=true`.

tia (sre): adding long-running monitors: compare live per-tenant quality metric vs baseline and alert if deviation > 5% for 1hr.

samir (ml-engineer): follow-ups I'll do: 1) reproduce the failure locally with the Acme promptset, 2) add unit/regression tests to quantization CI, 3) propose safer rollout policy for q8_fast_v2 (staged with tenant-specific holdouts). ETA initial repro: 48h.

grace (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll draft incident summary now and open a postmortem doc. Key timeline and decisions should be in the ticket. :thumbsup:

acme-support-bot: Ticket update created: INC-2025-ACME-471. Postmortem owners: samir (ml-engineer), grace (oncall), marta (platform).

karen (customer-success): I'll schedule a follow-up call with Acme next week to review postmortem and remediation plan. They asked for clearer change-control for tenant-sensitive pools.

grace (oncall): last note: if anyone needs to run a targeted search across logs for other tenants impacted by q8_fast_v2, use: ```bash
logs query "quant_profile:q8_fast_v2 AND model:*-assistant*" --since 2025-08-01 --group-by tenant
```
I'll sign off now. Thanks team. :heart:
